summary: Route an exception thrown by a process.nextTick callback through Node's uncaught-exception path rather than Promise rejection.

target.notes: Use the Node-compatible event-loop runtime; do not map ordering to arbitrary Task/ThreadPool scheduling.

semantics.throw_behavior: thrown value escapes the nextTick callback as an uncaught synchronous callback exception
semantics.promise: no Promise is created and no rejection is produced
semantics.host_hook: process uncaughtException handling may observe the failure

caveats: Do not reuse Promise rejection propagation for nextTick callback throws.
Process termination behavior depends on installed uncaughtException handlers and host policy.
